tests.title: Case 1 - Rotation is enabled when two monomers without bonds are selected
Case 2 - Rotation is enabled when two monomers with bonds are selected
Case 3 - Rotation is enabled when more than two monomers are selected regardless of bonds
Case 3b - Rotation is enabled when more than two disconnected monomers are selected
Case 4 - Rotation is not enabled when only one monomer is selected
Case 5 - Bounding box with rotation handle and center cross appears when two or more monomers are selected
Case 6 - Rotation, flip, and delete buttons are shown above the bounding box for selected monomers
Case 7 - Rotation angles are displayed near the bounding box while rotating
Case 8 - Default rotation angle is set to 15°
Case 9 - Rotation mode is activated by pressing left mouse button on the rotation handle
Case 10 - When rotation mode is deactivated, the selected fragment stays in its new position
Case 11 - Flip horizontally, flip vertically and delete buttons work as expected
Case 12 - Center of circle is at center of rotation and diameter equals bounding box height
Case 13 - Predefined angles are marked on the rotation circle: -90, -60, -45, -30, 0, 30, 45, 60, 90
Case 14 - Angles range always covers [-90 to +90] relative to the handle position when rotation starts
Case 15 - Current rotation angle is displayed at starting position when rotation starts
Case 16 - Ability to move the center of rotation in Macromolecules mode
